main_text.head: IN HVBERTVM PERDITISSIMUM NEBULONEM.

p.i: In Vrbe tota nullus histrio latet,
Nec mæchus Vllus, leno, scurráve impudens,
Cui non Hubertus iste sit notus bene.
Sed scire Vis ignotus hic cuisit? sibi.

main_text.head: DE IOHANNE SECVNDO Hagiensi, Poeta eximio.
main_text.p: EXcelsum seu condit opus, magnique Maro[?]n

p.i: Siue leues elegos, alternáque carmina, raptus
Siue lyram Variis sic aptat cantibus, Vt se
Siue iocos, blandósque sales epigrammate miscet
Vnus quattuor hac sic prastitit ille Secundus,

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of the lines, so the first verse line, the title line "PERD..." and the poem lines are incomplete; the visible letters are given. "A E[?]" at bottom right is partly cut off and may be "AD". "Vis" in the Hubertus poem and the word after "Maro" are doubtful. Long s is written as s throughout.
